pages.text: Acme Industries reported revenue of INR 1,260 crore in FY2025, compared with INR 1,120 crore in FY2024. Operating profit was INR 202 crore and operating cash flow was INR 176 crore.

Net income was INR 113 crore in FY2025. Total assets at 31 March 2025 were INR 2,600 crore. Current assets were INR 940 crore and current liabilities were INR 470 crore. Capital expenditure was INR 89 crore.

Total borrowings at 31 March 2025 were INR 285 crore. The reduction from the prior year reflects scheduled repayment and stronger operating cash generation. Cash and cash equivalents were INR 110 crore.
The company monitors liquidity, market and operational risks through quarterly management review. The risk committee reviewed liquidity limits four times during FY2025.
